contentHtml:
HSBC Bank Middle East Limited has announced its intention to wind down its business in Algeria following a detailed strategic review of its wholesale branch in the market. Image courtesy: HSBC Bank

The decision is part of the ongoing simplification of the HSBC Group as it focuses on increasing leadership and market share in the areas

Press Release

HSBC Bank Middle East Limited has announced its intention to wind down its business in Algeria following a detailed strategic review of its wholesale branch in the market. 

The decision is part of the ongoing simplification of the HSBC Group as it focuses on increasing leadership and market share in the areas where it has a clear competitive advantage and the greatest opportunities to grow and support its clients. 

HSBC is committed to supporting customers and colleagues and meeting all obligations to regulators, third parties and the wider market until the wind-down process is complete. 

Client engagement has begun and further updates will be provided over the coming months to support clients with their transition to suitable alternative banking providers in Algeria. 

HSBC has been deeply committed to the region for more than 130 years. We remain invested in its future and in the opportunities that lie ahead for its people, businesses, and economies.

Ahmad Othman ahmadothman@hsbc.com

HSBC Holdings plc 

HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of HSBC, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 56 countries and territories. With assets of US$3,445bn at 30 September 2026, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations. 

HSBC in the MENAT region

HSBC is the largest and most widely represented international banking organisation in the Middle East, North Africa and Türkiye (MENAT), with a presence in nine countries across the region: Algeria, Bahrain, Egypt, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and the United Arab Emirates. In Saudi Arabia, HSBC is a 31% shareholder of Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB), and a 51% shareholder of HSBC Saudi Arabia for investment banking in the Kingdom. Across MENAT, HSBC had assets of US$83bn as at 31 December 2025.

About HSBC Bank Middle East Limited, Algeria Branch

HSBC Algeria offers a full suite of banking products and services for Wholesale Banking customers, including government-related entities and multinational companies, through our local capabilities and international connectivity. Our award-winning Global Payment Solutions and Global Trade Solutions ensure seamless, secure and timely transaction capabilities for international businesses, and through our broad product capabilities, we provide access to Global Markets.
